title: Moro, interfaith groups slam renewed Gaza offensive

blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Moro civic leaders and interfaith peace advocates across Mindanao on Wednesday condemned renewed Israeli military operations and ground incursions in Gaza, demanding an immediate halt to the offensive and the unconditional withdrawal of Israeli troops.
